name: iridescent-ribbon
title: Iridescent Ribbon
description: A procedural iridescent light ribbon in one WebGL 2 shader: a travelling wave of red, green and blue bands that spreads into a soft color field.
label: mark-x64 ribbon shader
author: Mark By <https://github.com/mark-x64>

props.name: sequence
props.description: The wave, spread and fade, or the travelling wave on a loop.

props.name: loop
props.description: Repeats the sequence when it ends.

props.name: time
props.description: Shows one moment (seconds) and stops the clock, for stills.

props.name: amplitude | dispersion | glow | brightness
props.description: Wave height, color separation, glow and brightness.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the static picture shown without WebGL 2 or under reduced motion.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Reports the loop status, for example to hide playback controls without WebGL 2.

a11y: Decorative by default (aria-hidden); with aria-label it is role="img" with that name.
Reduced motion: nothing animates; a static SVG picture of the ribbon shows instead (also without WebGL 2 and before the first frame).
